# Repository instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`. For installing apps on a nearby watch or guiding hardware
tests, first read `hw-tests/AI-GUIDE.md` and `apps/<id>/HW-TESTS.md`.
Run the local shell BLE first-contact check before installing. Guide one step
at a time, wait for the human's observations, record measurements, and ask
before resets, flash filling or data deletion. Emulator success is not HW PASS.
